en.headline: Police investigate HK$520,000 cash theft from To Kwa Wan supermarket
en.dek: Staff at a budget supermarket on Tam Kung Road found the rear gate forced and two safes emptied of about HK$520,000; Kowloon City detectives are following up with no arrests yet.
body: Police received a report at about 9:43 a.m. on Sunday from a 65-year-old male employee at a supermarket on 34-38E Tam Kung Road in To Kwa Wan. He said the rear metal gate had been forced open and the premises appeared to have been entered overnight.

Officers arrived and confirmed that two office safes had been prised open. An initial count showed approximately HK$520,000 in cash was missing from the safes. The supermarket is identified as Yau Shing Supermarket.

The case has been classified as burglary and is being handled by the Kowloon City District Crime Squad Team 5. Police said no one has been arrested so far and enquiries are continuing, including reviews of nearby CCTV footage.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣友誠超市爆竊 失約52萬元現金 警正跟進
zh.dek: 周日早上超市職員發現後門被撬，兩個夾萬內約52萬元現金被盜；案件交九龍城警區刑偵隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方周日早上約9時43分接獲土瓜灣譚公道34至38E號一間超市65歲男職員報案，指發現後門鐵閘被撬毀，懷疑有人潛入爆竊。
警員到場調查後，確認辦公室內兩個夾萬被撬開，初步點算夾萬內共約52萬元現金不翼而飛。涉事超市為友誠食品平價超市。
案件列作爆竊，交由九龍城警區刑事調查隊第五隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。警方正翻查附近閉路電視，繼續調查。
